data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Dunia represents the material world and all the desires and pleasures that come with it. The name Dunia carries the meaning “World” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dunia usually hope their child will grow to embody world and live with faith, good character and purpose.
